title: Section — Daily Reports
description: Summaries of JobTread daily reports (one-way sync; last five days prioritized). Each report links to the full JobTread daily report and carries flags surfaced by meeting/workplace intelligence — rendered as highlight banners on the dashboard's date cards. Flag text stays factual and constructive.

photos.description: Photo URLs / data URIs from the report.

flags.description: Meeting / workplace-intelligence highlights shown as banners at the top of the card.
